classification.difficultyReason: Reads where each supplied curve lies above the x-axis, expresses the corresponding inside or outside intervals and excludes intercepts for the strict inequality.

content.prompt: For each of the parabolas shown below, find the values of $x$ for which $y>0$.

spec.description: Upward-opening schematic parabola; arrowed axes, coordinate labels, no ticks, grid or shading. Vertical scale is unspecified; the plotting coefficient is only a drawing parameter.
spec.mathematics: Zeros at -1 and 3; vertex below the x-axis and right of the y-axis.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph is visible; solution intervals are hidden.

answer.worked:
For $y>0$, the graph must lie above the $x$-axis. This occurs to the left of $x=-1$ and to the right of $x=3$. The intercepts are excluded because $y=0$ there.

Therefore, $x<-1$ or $x>3$.

spec.description: Upward-opening schematic parabola; arrowed axes, coordinate labels, no ticks, grid or shading. Retains the supplied (0,0) coordinate label. Vertical scale is unspecified; the plotting coefficient is only a drawing parameter.
spec.mathematics: Zeros at 0 and 4; vertex below the x-axis between the intercepts.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph is visible; solution intervals are hidden.

answer.worked:
The graph lies above the $x$-axis to the left of $x=0$ and to the right of $x=4$. The intercepts are excluded because the inequality is strict.

Therefore, $x<0$ or $x>4$.

spec.description: Downward-opening schematic parabola; arrowed axes, coordinate labels, no ticks, grid or shading. Retains the supplied (0,0) coordinate label. Vertical scale is unspecified; the plotting coefficient is only a drawing parameter.
spec.mathematics: Zeros at -3 and 0; vertex above the x-axis between the intercepts.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph is visible; solution interval is hidden.

answer.worked:
The graph lies above the $x$-axis between its intercepts, $x=-3$ and $x=0$. The intercepts are excluded because $y=0$ there.

Therefore, $-3<x<0$.

spec.description: Upward-opening schematic parabola; arrowed axes, coordinate labels, no ticks, grid or shading. Vertical scale is unspecified; the plotting coefficient is only a drawing parameter.
spec.mathematics: Zeros at -2 and 2; vertex on the y-axis below the x-axis.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph is visible; solution intervals are hidden.

answer.worked:
The graph lies above the $x$-axis to the left of $x=-2$ and to the right of $x=2$. The intercepts are excluded because the inequality is strict.

Therefore, $x<-2$ or $x>2$.
